art_direction: 青蓝侧马尾女性收起雨伞，在蓝紫绣球花旁停步欣赏水珠。
composition_variation: Create an original premium 2D anime wallpaper of exactly one woman, visibly 25 years old, with blue-teal hair in a low side ponytail with soft wisps curling beside her cheeks. She has mature, self-assured elegance and realistic adult proportions. Use clear sapphire eyes, an elegant narrow nose, soft natural brows, and a delighted expression suggesting she has just noticed a raindrop. Her opaque pale-yellow short-sleeved collared blouse pairs with a deep navy midi skirt and simple white flats. She has just stopped walking and holds a closed pale-gray umbrella vertically close to her side; her free hand lightly touches a hydrangea leaf at waist level. Blue, lilac, and white blooms cluster along a small garden path. Diffused post-rain daylight softens everything, with wet stone reflections, tiny beads of water, and a faint warm break in the clouds. Frame at eye level for a very tall phone crop. Keep her face, body, and hands inside the central narrow column, in the middle and lower image; leave the upper 25% calm and mostly empty for the clock. Natural nonsexual posture, opaque summer clothing, graceful anatomy, small readable hands close to her body. Refined linework, layered cel shading, painterly light, no text, logos, other people, or copied characters.
